visualCharacteristics: A grid of round icons with short captions, introduced by a heading and lead text and closed by a button. The bullets variant instead shows a panel with a heading, check-mark bullet points and a side image.
contentPattern: Optional intro row: [h2/h3 heading] [picture?] [text paragraphs]. One row per item: [icon picture] [caption text]. Optional closing row: [link paragraph] [note paragraph?]. In the icons variant a leading text-only row is the lead; in the bullets variant text rows before the heading row are the lead, the heading row holds the panel heading plus PC/SP pictures, and text rows after it become check bullets.
usage: Use it to present a set of services or features as icons with short labels.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for icon-plus-caption feature sets; pick cards or product-cards when items need titles, descriptions and individual links.
